answer: Sybil resistance is enforced by binding each agent to a unique proof-of-reserves ledger entry, so a duplicate identity appears as an unreconciled comet tail diverging from the audited balance sheet. Colluding agents attempting to spiral fake accounts into the ledger must post independent collateral per identity, and any orphaned relic of a prior attestation triggers. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
